guide.workspaceSummary: Understand the derived activation milestones and the next action selected by visible policy.
guide.workspace1: Review activation evidence on the Dashboard.
guide.workspace2: Open the recommended action and complete it in its authoritative surface.
guide.workspace3: Return to the Dashboard to see the read model update.
guide.brandSummary: Propose and explicitly approve immutable Brand Profile revisions.
guide.brand1: Review identity, audiences, voice, claims, and safety boundaries.
guide.brand2: Save corrections as a new draft revision.
guide.brand3: Approve the exact revision before creation can use it.
guide.inspirationSummary: Capture a lawful source, preserve attribution, and add only permitted influence to Blitz.
guide.inspiration1: Record the original source, rights status, region, and metric timestamp.
guide.inspiration2: Inspect why the item appears and which influence is permitted.
guide.inspiration3: Add it to Blitz; viewing alone never spends credits.
guide.contentSummary: Use a format definition, editable revision, 9:16 preview, and Render Proof boundary.
guide.content1: Choose one of the twelve complete Content Formats.
guide.content2: Pin language, Arabic variety, source assets, and creative direction.
guide.content3: Create candidates in AI Studio and retain every revision and lineage link.
guide.publishingSummary: Compose for exact Channels, validate settings, request approval, and monitor Delivery.
guide.publishing1: Select Channels and inspect each Platform preview and validation result.
guide.publishing2: Save or schedule through the canonical publishing record.
guide.publishing3: Use Approvals, Deliveries, and Calendar to recover without duplicate effects.
guide.recoverySummary: Read truthful provider state before cancellation, reconciliation, or retry.
guide.recovery1: Open Operations and select the affected run.
guide.recovery2: Inspect its event history, cost evidence, and outcome certainty.
guide.recovery3: Retry only a known-safe failure; reconcile an unknown outcome first.

releaseQuality.title: Release quality
releaseQuality.description: A fail-closed release decision across performance, WCAG 2.2 AA, flags, incidents, recovery, migrations, and Arabic/English parity.

gateHelp.performance: Versioned clients need current warm/cold MENA measurements for Web Vitals, APIs, critical actions, provider regions, and job stages.
gateHelp.accessibility: Every route/client/locale needs WCAG 2.2 AA evidence including focus restoration, live updates, captions, transcripts, and Arabic screen readers.
gateHelp.flags: Flags require explicit eligibility, dependencies, evaluation telemetry, rollback, expiry, safe defaults, and current evidence.
gateHelp.incidents: Any unresolved customer-impacting incident blocks release and reports operation, credit, and publishing risk.
gateHelp.recovery: RPO/RTO require encrypted regional backups, PITR, and current artifact/external-effect reconciliation drills.
gateHelp.migrations: Expand, migrate, and contract phases need resumable cursors, compatibility windows, and rollback evidence.
gateHelp.parity: Every signed route × feature × state × role × entitlement × viewport × direction cell needs current evidence and five independent sign-offs.
gateHelp.privacy: Product telemetry accepts only enumerated events and properties; prompts, content, assets, credentials, and free text are rejected.
